name: Ishq Mein Marjawan
overview: She had the perfect life, the perfect man but little did she know that she was walking into the perfect trap. What happens when the man you love turns out to be a genius manipulator?

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: A mysterious story about the life of Aarohi who has been married into a fake family setup full of con artists playing the role of her in-laws. The fake family frames her for a murder she did not commit, and she is jailed with her identity stolen! Watch how she plans the ultimate escape from prison to unravel the mystery and to avenge herself from the man who deceived and framed her.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: Kabir, a top cop, asks his girlfriend Ridhima to become a mole and enter the world of an alleged terrorist, Vansh and get sufficient proof to help implicate and arrest him. But what happens when Vansh proposes to marry Ridhima. Will she develop feelings for him or betray his love to only realize that Kabir had a personal vendetta against Vansh and this was his master plan to destroy him all along!

seasons.name: Fanaa - Ishq Mein Marjawan
seasons.overview: Pakhi is a simple girl who believes that she is the ‘Luckiest child of the Universe’. Everything has been destined in her favor. Agasthya is an irresistible billionaire with a brilliant mind. Their paths cross and they became the best of friends. Despite being from different backgrounds they could finish each other’s sentences. Everyone thought they would be great together, but is this all a play of destiny or something more?
